editorial_status: Draft definitions from source TRAIN; not independently annotated gold or tested quality gains

descriptions.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund was already requested or issued, but the refunded money has not appeared in the account.
descriptions.activate_my_card: How to activate a received card, or a problem while attempting card activation.
descriptions.age_limit: Age eligibility for opening or using an account, including accounts for children or minors.
descriptions.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using or setting up Apple Pay or Google Pay with the account or card, including top-ups.
descriptions.atm_support: Which ATMs or cash machines support withdrawals with this card.
descriptions.automatic_top_up: Setting up, using, changing or troubleshooting automatic account top-ups.
descriptions.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer was made into the account, but the account balance has not updated.
descriptions.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cash or cheque deposit has not yet appeared in the account balance.
descriptions.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer is blocked because the recipient or beneficiary is not allowed or supported.
descriptions.cancel_transfer: Cancel or stop a money transfer that has already been requested.
descriptions.card_about_to_expire: A card is expiring or has expired; renewing it or getting a replacement because of expiry.
descriptions.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used for payments, or merchants and situations where it is accepted.
descriptions.card_arrival: An ordered card has not arrived, is late, or needs tracking because delivery is overdue.
descriptions.card_delivery_estimate: Normal delivery time, delivery-date arrangements or faster shipping for an ordered card.
descriptions.card_linking: Link, add or restore a card in the app or account so that it appears there.
descriptions.card_not_working: The card is not working; no specific payment decline, contactless failure or virtual-card issue is identified.
descriptions.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or additional charge was applied to a payment made with the card.
descriptions.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment is shown that the customer did not make or does not recognize.
descriptions.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The currency-conversion rate applied to a card payment appears incorrect or worse than expected; distinguish a separate exchange fee.
descriptions.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the physical card; how to recover or replace it.
descriptions.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee was charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM; distinguish the exchange rate used for conversion.
descriptions.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal is recorded that the customer did not make or does not recognize.
descriptions.change_pin: Change the current card PIN to a different PIN.
descriptions.compromised_card: Suspected unauthorized use or compromise of the card or card details, including protecting the card.
descriptions.contactless_not_working: Contactless or tap-to-pay card payments are not working.
descriptions.country_support: Countries of residence or locations supported for opening or using the banking service.
descriptions.declined_card_payment: An attempted purchase or payment with the card was explicitly declined or rejected.
descriptions.declined_cash_withdrawal: An attempted cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or rejected.
descriptions.declined_transfer: A requested money transfer was declined or rejected; no specific prohibited beneficiary is identified.
descriptions.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unrecognized or unauthorized direct-debit payment taken from the account.
descriptions.disposable_card_limits: Limits, reuse rules or the number of available disposable virtual cards.
descriptions.edit_personal_details: Change personal account details such as name, address or contact information.
descriptions.exchange_charge: Fees, charges or discounts for exchanging currencies; distinguish the conversion rate itself.
descriptions.exchange_rate: Which currency exchange rate applies, or the general value of one currency in another.
descriptions.exchange_via_app: How or whether to exchange money from one currency to another in the account or app.
descriptions.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge on the statement, often a small one-unit amount, with no specific transaction fee identified.
descriptions.failed_transfer: A money transfer fails or cannot complete, without an explicit decline or prohibited beneficiary.
descriptions.fiat_currency_support: Which national currencies can be held as balances in the account.
descriptions.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to obtain or use a disposable virtual card, or what it is for; distinguish its limits.
descriptions.get_physical_card: How to obtain, find, view or receive the PIN for a card; distinguish changing an existing PIN or ordering a card.
descriptions.getting_spare_card: Getting an extra or spare card, including availability and charges for additional cards.
descriptions.getting_virtual_card: How to obtain or set up a regular virtual card; distinguish disposable virtual cards.
descriptions.lost_or_stolen_card: The physical card has been lost or stolen; how to report, block or replace it.
descriptions.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone has been lost or stolen; protecting or recovering access to the account.
descriptions.order_physical_card: How to order or obtain a physical payment card, including card-order cost and delivery destinations; not obtaining the PIN.
descriptions.passcode_forgotten: The account login passcode or password has been forgotten or is unknown; distinguish the card PIN.
descriptions.pending_card_payment: A card payment is pending or awaiting completion; what that status means or how long it takes.
descriptions.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is recorded as pending rather than completed.
descriptions.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending or awaiting completion, or a question about how long a top-up takes to go through.
descriptions.pending_transfer: A money transfer is recorded as pending and has not completed yet.
descriptions.pin_blocked: The card PIN has been blocked or too many incorrect PIN attempts were made.
descriptions.receiving_money: Receiving incoming payments such as salary or money paid by another person into this account.
descriptions.request_refund: How to request or obtain a refund for a purchase, including general process and timing before an overdue issued refund.
descriptions.reverted_card_payment?: A card purchase payment was reversed or returned to the account after being attempted or processed.
descriptions.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which external cards, card brands or funding currencies are accepted for topping up the account.
descriptions.terminate_account: Close, terminate or deactivate the account.
descriptions.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees or charges for funding the account through a bank-transfer top-up.
descriptions.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees or charges for topping up the account with an external payment card.
descriptions.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Whether or how to add money to the account using cash or a cheque.
descriptions.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt failed or could not be completed; distinguish a completed top-up later reversed.
descriptions.top_up_limits: Maximum amounts, frequency or other limits for account top-ups.
descriptions.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reversed, cancelled or returned after being attempted or processed.
descriptions.topping_up_by_card: How to add money using an external card, or an issue with that card top-up procedure; distinguish accepted card brands and fees.
descriptions.transaction_charged_twice: One transaction appears duplicated or the customer was charged twice for the same transaction.
descriptions.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for sending a money transfer; distinguish funding the account through a bank-transfer top-up.
descriptions.transfer_into_account: How to fund this account by transferring money from an external bank account, including bank linking and transfer instructions.
descriptions.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A sent transfer has not reached its recipient or the recipient says it was not received.
descriptions.transfer_timing: Normal time or arrival estimates for a money transfer, without a specific pending status or recipient non-receipt.
descriptions.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing or cannot be completed, including problems with verification evidence.
descriptions.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, or which documents and steps are required; no verification failure stated.
descriptions.verify_source_of_funds: Providing evidence of the origin of money or funds, such as requested source-of-funds documents.
descriptions.verify_top_up: Verifying ownership or authorization of a funding card used for a top-up, including the verification code.
descriptions.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card, including a disposable virtual card, is not working.
descriptions.visa_or_mastercard: Which card network the service issues or lets the customer choose, Visa or Mastercard; distinguish external cards accepted for top-ups.
descriptions.why_verify_identity: Why the service requires identity verification or an identity check.
descriptions.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM delivered a different amount of cash from the amount requested.
descriptions.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The currency-conversion rate used for a cash withdrawal appears wrong; distinguish the ATM withdrawal fee.

notes: Historical get_physical_card ID is retained, but its business description refers to PIN retrieval.
Some original source texts overlap or omit relevant context; descriptive repair is not full annotation of the corpus.
Descriptions were drafted and checked against TRAIN examples only; no held-out examples were read to select wording.
